Introduction

Driving in Kenya, whether through Nairobi's bustling streets or on a cross-country adventure, requires vigilance. A dash cam is no longer just a gadget for enthusiasts; it's a vital tool for documenting incidents, ensuring accountability, and even capturing unexpected scenic moments. The 70mai Dash Cam Pro Plus+ A500S Dual Channel emerges as a strong contender for Kenyan drivers seeking comprehensive protection and advanced features.

This premium dash cam goes beyond basic recording, offering crystal-clear video quality, intelligent driver assistance, and robust parking surveillance. At Trivo Kenya, we've taken a close look at what makes the A500S a smart investment for your vehicle.

Key Specifications

GPS Built-in
ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) Supported
Screen 2.0-inch IPS
Image Sensor Sony IMX335
Max Storage MicroSD up to 128GB (Class 10 U1/U3 recommended)
Resolution 2592 x 1944 (1944P Ultra HD)

Parking Monitoring 24-Hour (requires optional hardwire kit)

Design & Build

The 70mai A500S maintains a discreet and compact profile, designed to blend seamlessly behind your rearview mirror. Its black finish ensures it doesn't draw unnecessary attention, a practical consideration for vehicle security in Kenya. The build quality feels solid, made from durable plastics that can withstand varying cabin temperatures, a common occurrence in our equatorial climate.

The 2.0-inch IPS screen is bright enough for quick adjustments and reviewing footage, while the intuitive button layout makes navigating menus straightforward. Installation is typically simple, involving a sticky mount that adheres firmly to the windshield, and running the power cable along the vehicle's interior trim. The optional rear camera is equally compact, ensuring minimal obstruction to your rear view.

Performance

The star of the show is undoubtedly the 1944P Ultra HD resolution, powered by the Sony IMX335 sensor. This combination delivers exceptionally sharp and detailed footage, crucial for identifying license plates, road signs, and faces, even at speed or in challenging lighting conditions. Night vision is also impressive, utilizing a wide dynamic range (WDR) to balance exposure in low-light environments, making it effective for those late-night drives across town or on poorly lit highways.

The dual-channel recording means you get simultaneous footage from the front and rear of your vehicle, offering a complete picture of events. The built-in GPS accurately logs your speed and location, providing vital context for any incidents. Furthermore, the Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) feature provides real-time voice alerts for lane departure and forward collision warnings, adding an extra layer of safety, especially useful on Kenya's varied road conditions. The 24-hour parking monitoring, when paired with the optional hardwire kit, acts as a vigilant guardian, detecting impacts and recording footage even when your car is parked.
